prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original fan-made production sprite sheet for a side-view tactical video game, faithful to Metal Gear Solid V The Phantom Pain (1984). EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 independently DRAWN full-body poses of ONE same character. Pure flat magenta #FF00FF canvas with five thin continuous pure cyan #00FFFF vertical grid lines and five horizontal grid lines, including outer boundaries. Each equal square cell must contain exactly one complete character, wholly inside, generous empty margin at least 30 pixels, no extremity or equipment on guides. Fixed camera, strict orthographic RIGHT-facing profile, feet bottom aligned, identical physical scale every frame. Detailed crisp military pixel art, clear small-scale silhouette, no scenery, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark. The sixteen poses must be genuinely different drawings, never simple shifted duplicates. Four phases per row in left-to-right time order, preserve all costume and identity features in EVERY pose. Keep weapons and hands compact inside their cell. Subject: Kazuhira Miller in MGSV The Phantom Pain 1984 AFTER rescue. Canonical amputations mandatory: his RIGHT ARM is missing completely, coat right sleeve hangs EMPTY; his LEFT LEG is amputated above the knee, left trouser leg tied/folded up, NO left boot, NO artificial prosthetic. Only ONE intact natural RIGHT LEG and ONE intact LEFT ARM. Intact left hand grips a single gray FOREARM CRUTCH (elbow cuff and hand grip) extending to ground. Mature man blond swept-back hair, black military beret, dark aviator sunglasses, stubble. Tan-brown long trench coat, olive shirt/trousers, dark red necktie, black glove on his only left hand, ONE dark boot on right foot. Faithful to Konami TPP Miller official face and post-rescue concept. RIGHT-facing profile makes the empty right sleeve visible in foreground and crutch-supporting left arm visible slightly behind. Row1 four small idle weight-shift stages on one boot plus crutch. Row2 four slow rightward crutch-assisted movement phases: plant crutch ahead, transfer weight, single right foot advances, settle; NEVER a two-legged walk. Row3 four gentle nod/conversation stages while left hand stays holding crutch, empty sleeve stays empty. Row4 four small controlled forward bend and recovery with crutch supporting balance. No blood, wounds covered, no floating marks. Exactly one full natural leg, one natural arm and one forearm crutch in EVERY frame.

references.kind: secondary mirror of attributed Konami/Shinkawa concept and game model

notes: Right arm and left leg absent in all16 poses; empty coat sleeve, one boot, one forearm crutch held by remaining left hand.
Gait is single-leg crutch-assisted, no invented prosthesis.
16 authored four-action archive poses; exact1:1 likeness and perfect motion continuity are not claimed.
